name: E. coli DH5α Long-Read Assembly Benchmark
description: Evaluates performance of long-read genome assemblers and preprocessing strategies specifically on bacterial (E. coli DH5α) datasets, measuring metrics like contiguity, accuracy, and completeness.
evaluation_method: composite_score (assembly metrics such as N50/NGA50, consensus accuracy, completeness/BUSCO)
typical_sota_score: near-complete assemblies are common — often >=99.9% consensus identity and single-contig circular assemblies for high-quality long reads
reputation: A specialized benchmark used in long-read assembler evaluations for bacterial genomes, valued for assessing end-to-end assembler and preprocessing performance on E. coli.
notes: Small bacterial genome dataset — risk of saturation and limited generalizability to large/complex genomes; results depend strongly on read chemistry and coverage.
